chapter: Joining Raeburn and work for other leaders
title: Playing with Freddie Slack
summary: He wrote a few charts and played piano for Slack's band, backing his sister-in-law Ella Mae Morse.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: What did you do with Freddie Slack, anything of any real significance?
A few charts, played on the road with him.
Were you a boogie-woogie piano player?
Other than those particular things, I played and he would front.
He didn't front the band from the piano then?
Ella Mae was on that band, wasn't she?

Right. This wasn't the original band that she had done the 'Cow Cow Boogie' with; this was years later when she was an established star on her own, and she was the star of the show and the band, for the show, happened to be Freddie Slack.
But she wasn't singing with the band, she was the number one headline. His band had the show, and she was my sister-in-law.
